name: Dental implants
summary: How expats plan dental implants in Singapore — CBCT planning, staged vs immediate load, dental rider limits, and travel timing around osseointegration.
body:
Dental implants replace missing teeth with titanium fixtures and crowns. Planning usually needs CBCT, bone assessment, and a clear staged timeline. Dental riders often cap implants heavily or exclude them — read schedules before quoting packages.

## Decision points
- Single implant vs bridge vs denture alternatives
- Bone graft / sinus lift needs before fixture placement
- Immediate load vs delayed crown after osseointegration
- Specialist oral surgeon / prosthodontist vs general dentist pathway
- Travel gaps between surgery and abutment/crown visits

Smoking, uncontrolled diabetes, and grinding change risk — disclose honestly.

## How to choose
Prefer clinics that show the CBCT plan and implant brand on paper. Ask who covers night swelling calls. Confirm whether temporary teeth are included during healing.

## Practical tip
Block two soft-food weeks after placement before big client dinners. Stock porridge ingredients before surgery day — Grab decisions hurt with a sore jaw.
